entry.title: dotnet/runtime - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-08-16
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Trimmer: Static function pointer should not keep function alive if its never read #118816
  • Overflowing negative constants in printed x64 assembly #118813
  • Redundant test after `PopCount` #118811
    Future
  • Consider emitting more performant codegen for looped switch statement, such as that found in a simple interpreter #118809
    Future
  • Please switch from HMAC to EVP MAC APIs #118807
    11.0.0
  • Remove unnecessary pinning over non-unloadable RVA fields #118802
    11.0.0

Closed

  • Redundant TEST instruction after ADD #117866
    Future
  • [API Proposal]: AsyncEnumerable.Chunk #118815
  • Massive performance regression .NET 9 vs .NET 10 #115033
    10.0.0
  • Bug: JsonPolymorphic fails with case-insensitive discriminator property name #118786
  • [API Proposal]: ML-DSA + COSE #116942
    10.0.0
  • Excessive CPU and memory usage (70+ GB) when running analyzers #118121
    10.0.0

PullRequests

Created

  • Serialize negative constants according to the operand type #118814
    community-contribution, needs-area-label
  • [release/10.0-rc1] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #118810
    area-codeflow
  • Convert pattern to clear LSBs into a mask operation #118808
    area-CodeGen-coreclr, community-contribution
  • Elide redundant test instruction for signed comparison predicates #118806
    area-CodeGen-coreclr, community-contribution
  • [release/10.0] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #118805
    area-codeflow

Merged

  • Rc1 mopup #118812
    linkable-framework, area-NativeAOT-coreclr
  • Introduce size-optimized IListSelect iterator #118156
    area-System.Linq, size-reduction
  • Fix registry key handle leak in EventLogEntry. #118771
    area-System.Diagnostics.EventLog, community-contribution
  • Add better explanation to AnalysisCharacteristicAttribute #118799
    area-NativeAOT-coreclr
  • Add limit on trim analyzer CFG convergence iterations #118760
    linkable-framework, area-Tools-ILLink, 10.0.0

Updated

  • Implement UnhandledException hook for finalizer scenario in Mono. #118563
    area-VM-meta-mono, runtime-mono, linkable-framework
  • Port the Shared Mutex logic from CoreCLR PAL to work alongside the managed wait subsystem #117635
    area-System.Threading, blocked, 11.0.0
  • Fix file size estimation when bundling symlinks #118732
    area-HostModel, community-contribution
  • [S390X] Add simd fallback support for unsupported s390x architectures #118376
    area-Codegen-JIT-mono, arch-s390x, community-contribution
